title: Specialisation
description: The armour grows in many directions at once, but its capacity is <warning>finite</warning>. Trying to master everything yields mastery of nothing. Consider forging multiple chestplates, each trained for a specific purpose, such as a miner's set, a warrior's set, or an explorer's set. The <keyword>Vitaemancer</keyword> has devised Rituals to assist with focused training, and the <property>Ritual of Sentient Evolution</property> to imbue your armour with a greater capacity for growth. Stand upon the <named>Master Ritual Stone</named> while clad in <named>Sentient Armor</named>, and the circle pours its power into the symbiotic plates. The armour's potential <positive>expands</positive> beyond its former limits.
